title: feat: Payments refund endpoint with partial refund support
author: riya.desai
description:
Implements POST /payments/refund endpoint (NEX-215).

Key features:
- Full refund: omit amount parameter
- Partial refund: specify amount ≤ original charge
- Partial refund edge case fix: validates that cumulative partial refunds do not exceed the original charge amount (discovered during implementation, mentioned in standup_02)
- Writes refund event to payment_audit_log before processing (PCI-DSS — NEX-219)
- Returns: { refund_id, status, refunded_amount, remaining_refundable }
- Full integration test suite: 23 test cases including edge cases

Related: NEX-215, NEX-204, NEX-219, standup_02

review_comments.author: arjun.mehta
review_comments.comment: The cumulative partial refund check is exactly right. Good edge case catch. Test coverage is excellent.
